label: PAX3::FOXO1

sections.text: PAX3 encodes a paired-box transcription factor involved in neural-crest and skeletal-muscle development.
FOXO1 encodes a forkhead transcription factor involved in metabolism, differentiation and cell survival.
The fusion combines paired-box DNA binding with the FOXO1 transactivation region, generating a potent abnormal transcription factor that drives fusion-positive rhabdomyosarcoma.
PAX3::FOXO1 is associated with adverse outcomes in rhabdomyosarcoma and contributes to FOXO1-fusion-based risk stratification.
